iid_published.note: as published (phase89.order_temperature): iid errors, df n-k; ignores the 39 within-cell centrings

iid_df_corrected.note: iid errors, df reduced by the 39 cell means removed by centring

cluster_block_CR1.note: cluster-robust by block (CR1), t with G-1 = 11 df

cluster_cell_CR1.note: cluster-robust by cell (CR1), t with G-1 = 38 df

twoway_block_cell_CGM.note: Cameron-Gelbach-Miller two-way (block, cell); non-PSD part clipped; t with min(G)-1 = 11 df

limitations: 12 blocks and 39 cells are few clusters. CR1 with G-1 df can still be anti-conservative with 12 clusters; the wild cluster bootstrap (exact enumeration of the 4,096 sign vectors) is the more reliable p-value. Blocks ran back to back in one ~2 h session on one host: they are within-session replicates, not independent days or hosts. Position and temperature are partly confounded within a block.
